kind: read-only profile attribution, not an optimization result
method: perf script -G -F tid,period,ip,sym,symoff,dso; filter exact foreground TID and symbol; sum recorded cycle periods by symbol-relative sample IP

ranges.inlined_api_and_call_return_plumbing: remaining sampled offsets of this symbol

caveats: These whole-worker profiles include warmup and verification.
Cycle-sample IP has PMU skid; the groups are code-range attribution, not exact individual instruction latency.
The benchmark closure contains inlined cache and facade work, including returned transaction copies; it is not all workload generation.
Launch-to-after-snapshot wall time includes startup, warmup, verification, teardown, and the environment snapshot. That wall duration is not the throughput or PMU denominator.
